display.purpose: Largest page titles and high-authority hero moments.

headline.purpose: Hero titles, section titles, and major page headings.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, small UI labels, and control legends.

metadata.purpose: Counts, sources, and secondary operational information.

brand.purpose: The Seamless and Philippine wordmark role only.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default state transitions for buttons, links, and cards.

motion.name: ease-quick
motion.purpose: Fast highlight changes such as search results.

motion.name: ease-rotation
motion.purpose: The subtle header icon rotation on hover.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main call to action, used for obvious next steps.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn ds-btn-primary">Homepage <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7 17 10-10"></path><path d="M9 7h8v8"></path></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 23px; border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--accent); color: #fff; font-family: inherit; font-size: .9rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary svg { width: 1em; height: 1em; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 1.7; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { border-color: var(--accent-hover); background: var(--accent-hover); transform: translateY(-1px); outline: 0; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The supporting CTA that stays quieter than the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 23px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--text); font: inherit; font-size: .9rem; font-weight: 500; transition: border-color 180ms ease, background-color 180ms ease, color 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover, .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { border-color: var(--text); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 50%, transparent); outline: 0; transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Tag Chip
components.description: A compact metadata chip used for tags and quick filters.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 7px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface-strong); color: var(--muted); font-family: inherit; font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.15; text-decoration: none; text-transform: lowercase; transition: color 180ms ease, background-color 180ms ease; } .ds-chip:hover, .ds-chip:focus-visible { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-strong) 82%, var(--accent)); color: var(--accent); outline: 0; }

components.name: App Card
components.description: The recurring content card for app listings and related recommendations.
components.html:
Chimlo

Tracks Codex and Claude Code sessions from the MacBook notch.

Best for: Developers supervising several coding agents.

aideveloper
components.css: .ds-card { display: grid; gap: 16px; min-height: 286px; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 96%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 18px 55px rgba(27, 35, 42, 0.08); transition: box-shadow 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease, background-color 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0; font-family: var(--display); font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.15; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: .95rem; line-height: 1.55; } .ds-card-kicker strong { color: var(--text); } .ds-chip-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; align-content: flex-start; } .ds-card:hover, .ds-card:focus-within { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 42%, var(--line)); background: var(--surface); box-shadow: 0 26px 68px rgba(27, 35, 42, 0.14); transform: translateY(-2px); outline: 0; }

components.name: Site Header
components.description: The sticky shell that carries the brand, search, archive, and theme controls.
components.html:
App Waypoint
Archive
components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 28px; min-height: 84px; padding: 0 38px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--header-fog); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(115%); } .ds-brand, .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; } .ds-brand { gap: 21px; color: var(--text); font-family: "Seamless", "Philippine", var(--display); font-size: clamp(1.65rem, 2.45vw, 2rem); letter-spacing: .12em; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-brand-mark { width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 50%; background: #f7f0e4; } .ds-nav { gap: 42px; } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; padding: 9px 0; color: var(--text); font-size: .88rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link::after { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 1px; left: 0; height: 1px; background: currentColor; content: ''; opacity: 0; transform: scaleX(.65); transition: opacity 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link.is-active { color: var(--accent); } .ds-nav-link:hover::after, .ds-nav-link.is-active::after { opacity: 1; transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-icon-btn { display: grid; width: 38px; height: 38px; padding: 0; place-items: center; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text); transition: color 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-icon-btn svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 1.7; } .ds-icon-btn:hover, .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { color: var(--accent); transform: rotate(12deg); outline: 0; }

components.name: Directory Filter Menu
components.description: The compact filter popover used on tag and collection archive pages.
components.html: Apps must match every selected filter.
components.css: .ds-filter { position: relative; width: 268px; color: var(--text); font: inherit; } .ds-filter-trigger { display: flex; width: 100%; min-height: 38px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 7px 13px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); font: inherit; font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 800; } .ds-count { display: inline-flex; min-width: 19px; height: 19px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 5px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface-strong); color: var(--muted); font-size: .75rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-filter-panel { margin-top: -1px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0 0 10px 10px; background: var(--surface); box-shadow: 0 18px 55px rgba(27, 35, 42, 0.08); } .ds-filter-note { margin: 0; padding: 11px 13px 9px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--muted); font-size: .76rem; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-filter-option { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 7px 13px; color: var(--text); font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Search Modal
components.description: The centered search overlay that covers the site with a controlled, frosted backdrop.
components.html: 12 RESULTS
components.css: .ds-search { position: fixed; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: start center; padding: min(9vh, 92px) 20px 24px; } .ds-search-backdrop { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 16%, transparent), transparent 38%), rgba(2, 11, 24, 0.52); backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(110%); } .ds-search-panel { position: relative; z-index: 1; width: min(820px, 100%); overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 18px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 98%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 30px 90px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28); } .ds-search-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 18px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-search-input { width: 100%; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text); font: inherit; font-size: clamp(1.1rem, 2vw, 1.45rem); font-weight: 600; outline: 0; } .ds-search-input::placeholder { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--muted) 78%, transparent); } .ds-search-close { display: grid; width: 36px; height: 36px; place-items: center; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); } .ds-search-close:hover, .ds-search-close:focus-visible { border-color: var(--line); background: var(--surface-strong); color: var(--text); outline: 0; } .ds-search-count { margin: 0; padding: 10px 20px 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; }

narrative.overview:
App Waypoint feels like a calm dock at first light: warm paper, deep-water text, and a single reliable blue used sparingly so the page never shouts. It is editorial rather than promotional, organized like a magazine, but laid out like a utility. Dense information sits inside soft cards and quiet section breaks instead of loud banners.

The language prefers stable geometry, soft depth, and generous breathing room. Serif headlines carry the authority; the system sans supports the utility layers, controls, and metadata. The result is familiar and trustworthy, with enough atmosphere to feel considered but not styled for its own sake.
keyCharacteristics: Warm sand-and-cream surfaces with navy ink.
Beacon blue reserved for actions and current states.
Dense content organized through cards, chips, and careful spacing.

rules.name: The Beacon Rule
rules.body: Blue is reserved for actions, links, focus, and active states. It should not become page chrome or decorative noise.

rules.name: The Serif-Utility Split
rules.body: Serif type carries the editorial voice; the system sans carries the operational voice. Mixing them casually weakens both jobs.

rules.name: The Soft Hull Rule
rules.body: Surfaces lift with a soft shadow and a border change, not with hard edges or dramatic offsets.

dos: Do keep the warm paper base, deep-sea text, and blue accent in a tight relationship.
Do reuse the shared page shell so archive, tag, collection, about, and app pages line up.
Do keep shadows soft and ambient.
Do let serif headlines carry the editorial voice while system sans handles utility.
Do keep the defining tag or collection locked when it is the page’s own context.
donts: Don't introduce loud secondary colors just to add energy.
Don't replace the soft shadow system with hard offsets or heavy glow.
Don't use tinted text as neutral gray on colored surfaces.
Don't make chips, filters, or buttons feel like separate UI worlds.
Don't let the brand wordmark typography spread into body copy.
